name: PowerShell
readme_excerpt: ![logo][] PowerShell Welcome to the PowerShell GitHub Community! PowerShell is a cross-platform (Windows, Linux, and macOS) automation and configuration tool/framework that works well with your existing tools and is optimized for dealing with structured data (e.g. JSON, CSV, XML, etc.), REST APIs, and object models. It includes a command-line shell, an associated scripting language, and a framework for processing cmdlets. [logo]: assets/psblack64.svg?sanitize=true Windows PowerShell vs. PowerSh…
